summary: Bound human mission-run tree reads with an indexed root page and explicit continuation

replay.detail: No claim replay or checkpoint replay changes. Existing mission rows are read through a new SQLite index built during Store initialization.

schema.detail: Adds mission_runs_root_page_index on root_run_id, created_at_unix_ms and id without a schema-version change. Existing stores build the index when first opened by this version; mission rows and claims are not rewritten.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, graph digests or coordinated member versions change.

compatibility.detail: The human st missions show and follow commands use the new GET /v1/mission-runs/tree route. Older CLIs and the existing all-descendants route remain supported. A new CLI against an older daemon cannot use the new human tree route; exact-run JSON still uses the single-run route.

downtime.detail: Index build time on existing large mission_runs tables and restart-to-API time have not been measured. The index is created during Store initialization; operators should allow for that work before expecting the daemon to serve requests.

manual.detail: No data migration command, re-pairing or configuration change is required. Deploy the daemon with the new route before relying on a newer CLI's human tree command; stored identity and mission state are preserved.

recovery.detail: A previous binary can read the unchanged mission rows and ignores the extra SQLite index. Swapping binaries does not remove the index or undo any mission state.
